question: Owner 2026-11-01 '围绕5min插针收盘这个特点，展开分析，收盘之后，有哪些还有不错的盈利空间的': which touch-bar facts known at the touch 5m close still leave profit for a market entry at that close?
single_variable: Event selection by one touch-bar fact at a time (score band, close inside / beyond, wick depth, recovery, volume ratio, same-bar cluster, side), alone and within score >= 0.5; fills, targets, stop, fees and slippage of the close-reclaim run unchanged.
selection: candidate: 2020-2024 n >= min_n, mean net > 0 and cluster-bootstrap 95 percent lower bound > 0; survives: 2025-2026 pooled lower bound > 0 and 2025 and 2026 means each > 0. Clusters are side x touch bar.
null: The same target's all-touch close-entry mean per period (baseline); survivors still need a matched random-time control before any paper account.
fees: As the source: taker entry 0.05 percent, maker target 0.02, taker stop / reclaim exits (OKX Lv1, read 2026-10-23); 10bp slippage on the market entry and on non-target exits; worse of the two intrabar paths
in_sample: The score and the close-reclaim targets were built on 2020-2024 data and looked at on the full history; 2025-2026 is the test only for the slice selection here
